children: Mobile Infrastructure entered into a Fifth Amendment to its Credit Agreement with Harvest Small Cap Partners and Harvest Small Cap Partners Master to extend the facility’s maturity from September 30, 2026 to December 31, 2026. The amendment, signed on September 22, 2026, provides additional time and liquidity flexibility as the company advances its financing plans. Terms otherwise remain subject to the existing Credit Agreement.
: Fifth Amendment to Credit Agreement (maturity extension)
: Harvest Small Cap Partners and Harvest Small Cap Partners Master
: Extend credit maturity to provide short-term liquidity and flexibility
